content: The dosage of this medication is determined based on your medical condition, body weight, response to an initial test dose, and overall response to treatment. If you are administering this medication at home, it is essential to thoroughly learn all preparation and usage instructions from your healthcare provider. Before use, visually inspect the product for any particles or discoloration; if either is present, do not use the liquid. Infusion reactions may occur during the administration of this drug. To minimize these side effects, your doctor may prescribe additional medications, such as acetaminophen, diphenhydramine, or corticosteroids like hydrocortisone, before each treatment. Notify your doctor immediately if you experience symptoms of an infusion reaction, including fever, shaking, chills, flushing, loss of appetite, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, headache, shortness of breath, or rapid breathing. For certain infections, it may be necessary to continue this medication for several weeks to months. Remember, this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare. However, this is not a comprehensive list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar guidance. Before using amphotericin, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose with severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. While using this medication, regular laboratory and medical tests (e.g., kidney and liver function, potassium and magnesium levels, complete blood counts) should be conducted. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. Proper storage of this medication is crucial; consult the product instructions and your pharmacist for specific storage details. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Discard this product properly when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
